name: Tsumi
source:
The character in the [url=/c5567]Hishakaku[/url] pre-story.

A ghost of a poor child abandoned by her own mother to starve. Unable to find any food, Tsumi soon died and was turned into a ghost. She now wanders the village in search for some food and soon meets Hishakaku who becomes her only friend.
